title: DHCP Helper-Address Multi-Subnet Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose and resolve multi-subnet DHCPv4 helper-address forwarding failures across routed subinterfaces and a central Cisco IOS DHCP server. Troubleshoot helper-address configuration faults, 802.1Q subinterface gateway mappings, and DHCP pool scope mismatches preventing remote branch clients from obtaining dynamic IP leases.
learning_objectives: Diagnose and resolve DHCP relay failures across multiple 802.1Q VLANs using Cisco IOS verification tools
Understand the operation of ip helper-address converting broadcast DHCP Discover messages to routed unicast
Identify and correct helper-address misconfigurations including wrong destination IP and missing relay bindings
Identify and correct DHCP pool scope mismatches on the central DHCP server where network subnets do not match giaddr
Verify end-to-end lease acquisition, gateway distribution, and inter-VLAN routing connectivity across remote subnets

source.origin: Independently authored enterprise network services troubleshooting lab based on IETF RFC 2131 standards and Cisco IOS DHCP relay documentation
